Title: Verify error banner appears inside the Create User form when a duplicate email is submitted
Description: This test case aims to verify error banner appears inside the create user form when a duplicate email is submitted.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Users page. 2. Click the Add User button. 3. Fill in Full Name, Phone, Email (use an email already registered), Job Function, Assigned Role, and Assigned Company. 4. Click the Create User button.
Outcome: 1. The Users page is displayed with the user table. 2. The Create User dialog opens with all required fields. 3. All fields are filled with valid data except the email is a duplicate. 4. An error banner is displayed inside the Create User dialog indicating the user already exists.
Preconditions: User must be logged in with admin permissions. At least one user must already exist in the system.

Title: Verify error banner is NOT a toast notification when Create User fails
Description: This test case aims to verify error banner is not a toast notification when create user fails.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Users page. 2. Click the Add User button. 3. Fill in all required fields using an already registered email. 4. Click the Create User button. 5. Check the page for toast notifications.
Outcome: 1. Users page loads correctly. 2. Create User dialog opens. 3. All fields filled. 4. Form is submitted. 5. No toast notification appears — the error is shown as a banner inside the dialog.
Preconditions: User must be logged in with admin permissions.

Title: Verify error banner displays a descriptive message when Create User fails
Description: This test case aims to verify error banner displays a descriptive message when create user fails.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Users page. 2. Click the Add User button. 3. Fill in all required fields with a duplicate email. 4. Click the Create User button.
Outcome: 1-3. Form is filled and submitted. 4. The error banner inside the dialog displays a specific, descriptive error message (not a generic one).
Preconditions: User must be logged in with admin permissions.

Title: Verify the Create User dialog remains open after a service error
Description: This test case aims to verify the create user dialog remains open after a service error.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Users page. 2. Click the Add User button. 3. Fill in all required fields with a duplicate email. 4. Click the Create User button.
Outcome: 1-3. Dialog is open and filled. 4. The dialog stays open — it does not close after the error — allowing the user to correct the data and retry.
Preconditions: User must be logged in with admin permissions.

Title: Verify error banner is dismissed when the Create User dialog is closed
Description: This test case aims to verify error banner is dismissed when the create user dialog is closed.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Users page. 2. Click the Add User button. 3. Trigger a service error by submitting a duplicate email. 4. Click the Close button on the dialog. 5. Click the Add User button again.
Outcome: 1-3. Error banner is visible inside the dialog. 4. Dialog closes. 5. A fresh Create User dialog opens with no error banner visible.
Preconditions: User must be logged in with admin permissions.

Title: Verify error banner is dismissed when user corrects the email and resubmits successfully
Description: This test case aims to verify error banner is dismissed when user corrects the email and resubmits successfully.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Users page. 2. Click the Add User button. 3. Submit the form with a duplicate email to trigger the error banner. 4. Clear the Email field and enter a unique valid email. 5. Click the Create User button.
Outcome: 1-3. Error banner appears inside the dialog. 4. Email field is updated with a new unique email. 5. The user is created successfully, the dialog closes, and no error banner is shown.
Preconditions: User must be logged in with admin permissions. A unique email must be available for resubmission.

Title: Verify error banner position is inside the Create User dialog (not outside)
Description: This test case aims to verify error banner position is inside the create user dialog (not outside).
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Users page. 2. Click the Add User button. 3. Submit the form with a duplicate email. 4. Inspect the position of the error message.
Outcome: 1-3. Error is triggered. 4. The error banner is rendered inside the Create User dialog, above or below the form fields, and not outside the modal boundaries.
Preconditions: User must be logged in with admin permissions.

Title: Verify error banner matches the visual style of the Create Company form error banner
Description: This test case aims to verify error banner matches the visual style of the create company form error banner.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Companies page. 2. Click Add Company and trigger a service error. 3. Note the banner style. 4. Navigate to the Users page. 5. Click Add User and trigger a service error. 6. Compare both banners.
Outcome: 1-3. Company form error banner style is noted. 4-6. User form error banner matches the same visual style (color, icon, placement) as the company form error banner.
Preconditions: User must be logged in with admin permissions.

Title: Verify required field validation errors are not affected by this change
Description: This test case aims to verify required field validation errors are not affected by this change.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Users page. 2. Click the Add User button. 3. Leave all required fields empty. 4. Attempt to click Create User.
Outcome: 1-3. Empty dialog is open. 4. The Create User button remains disabled or individual field validation errors appear — the service error banner change does not interfere with client-side validation.
Preconditions: User must be logged in with admin permissions.
